🚀 thehumanbox | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a free, accessible, and client-side civilization simulation sandbox where users can observe or interact with emergent societal development.
✨ Key Features: • Autonomous tribal development (language, culture, cities, religion, war, treaties) • Runs entirely in the browser via WebAssembly (no server, no LLM)
📖 Summary: The Human Box is a free, browser-based civilization sandbox simulation written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly. It allows users to observe or influence autonomous tribes as they develop languages, cultures, technologies, and engage in complex societal interactions from the stone age to the computer age, all running client-side without a server or LLM.
